title: The ending's epilogue ('How the realm remembers you') revealed an entire unvisited hold (Gullhaven — 'the drowned fleet still rows the fog off Gullhaven's point') and a whole other central grief in a hold I did visit (Barrowmere's 'great mound... waiting on someone else', plus a parallel 'Old Court Verses: 0/3' track in Marrowgate itself), none of which were ever surfaced as an active lead by any quest-giver or status line while I was physically in those places.
